$comment: Single source of truth for every visual asset. status: placeholder = generated stand-in, must be replaced; wip = real art, still being iterated; final = approved. `file` is relative to src/assets. Entries with kind 'pixels' are tiny sprites authored inline as palette-indexed rows (palette names refer to PALETTE in src/game/GameConfig.ts).

assets.usage: The player's soul in battle: a lost-and-found claim tag. Also the title-screen ornament.
assets.brief: Pointed claim tag with a punched hole. Needs a hit flash frame and a 'torn' variant for the defeat sequence.
Hand-lettered 'UNCLAIMED' wordmark, slightly uneven like a stamped label, with a claim tag hanging from the final D on a string. Two variants: normal and 'faded' (used after certain endings).

assets.usage: Title screen backdrop (currently a procedural stand-in: light shaft and falling lint).
assets.brief: The bottom of the Lost & Found drop chute seen from below: a heap of forgotten objects, a single shaft of light from the slot above, dust motes. Layered for subtle parallax (3 layers).

assets.usage: Development test room floor/wall tiles. Not shipped.
assets.brief: Development only; replaced by area tilesets in PHASE 2.

assets.usage: Player overworld sprite: idle and walk in 4 directions. The left mitten shows on the correct hand when facing left.
assets.brief: Child in an oversized mustard raincoat, red boots, one teal mitten. Next: run, surprised, sad, laugh, sit.

assets.usage: Ledger's overworld sprite (idle with blink, glance and bob).
assets.brief: Small green hardcover registry book on stubby legs, ribbon bookmark. Next: walk cycle, flustered page-flutter.

assets.usage: Ledger's dialogue portrait: neutral, nervous, happy, sad, surprised.
assets.brief: Cover-as-face with round glasses. Next: talking mouth frames, 'ink blot' embarrassed face.
Tiny desk, ink pad, rubber stamp. Next: stamping animation when saving.

assets.usage: Interaction hint and battle command icons (white, tinted at runtime).
assets.brief: 10x10 icons: talk, clear (broom), act, pocket, let go.

assets.usage: Bullet frames for all enemy patterns.
assets.brief: 8x8: dot, wires, plug, note, spark, receipt digits, paper scrap.

assets.usage: Tileset for the chute bottom, sorting room and umbrella path.
assets.brief: Plank floors, lint, cracks, lit floor, walls, chute, shelves, boxes, pile, sign, door, rug, umbrellas. Next: forest tileset.
Knot of white cord with two buds and a plug. Next: untangled/loose frames per mercy state.
Long curled faded receipt with a torn bottom. Next: 'remembered' happy frame.
